environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Project root path has spaces: `c:\Users\DELL\Pictures\Downloads\PRO-PANDIT WEB SITE\gokarna-sarva-poojas` — always quote this path in shell commands. Do NOT start the dev server. Do NOT run `npm run dev`. Build verification only.
contribution_requirements: 1. Never touch src/app/api/** routes. 2. Never touch src/lib/supabase.ts, src/lib/validations/booking.ts, src/lib/utils.ts. 3. Form logic (useForm, zodResolver, register, handleSubmit, watch, fetch calls) must be preserved verbatim — only class name strings change. 4. No new npm packages. 5. Tailwind v4: all custom tokens live in @theme {} in globals.css — no tailwind.config.js. 6. Image paths must not be renamed or moved.
key_patterns: 1. All UI components use `cn()` from src/lib/utils.ts for class merging. 2. Framer Motion: `motion.div` with `initial/animate/whileInView` and `viewport={{ once: true }}` pattern everywhere. 3. `PageTransition` wrapper from src/components/layout/page-transition.tsx wraps every page's return. 4. cva (class-variance-authority) used in Button for variants. 5. Tailwind v4 CSS variables: tokens defined as `--color-NAME: VALUE` in @theme become utilities `bg-NAME`, `text-NAME`, `border-NAME` automatically. Opacity variants like `bg-gold/20` work out of the box. 6. All pages are `use client` (no server components in src/app/* pages). 7. Layout components (Navbar, Footer, WhatsAppButton, WelcomePopup) are imported in src/app/layout.tsx and shared globally.
directory_structure: src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages and API routes; src/app/api/booking/ — API route (DO NOT TOUCH); src/components/layout/ — Navbar, Footer, WhatsAppButton, WelcomePopup, PageTransition; src/components/ui/ — Button, Card, SectionHeading, Breadcrumb, Logo; src/lib/ — constants.ts, utils.ts, supabase.ts, puja-data.ts, blog-data.ts, validations/booking.ts; public/images/gallery/signature/ — s1.jpeg through s20.jpeg (real gallery photos); public/images/ — hero-bg.jpg and other page images
